decisionRule: Prefer a small, source-backed data product that changes what a walker can do or notice over a large undifferentiated catalogue.

rankedAdditions.whyNow: The app already has journey loading, route selection, entrance markers, and map rendering; the missing value is a small set of editor-reviewed loops with entrances, cautions, and source evidence.
rankedAdditions.firstRelease: Six DC/Fairfax loops across distinct neighborhoods and landscapes.
rankedAdditions.acceptance: Every loop has a bounded geometry, verified entrance, distance/time estimate, accessibility note, seasonal caution, and source record.

rankedAdditions.whyNow: The News UI and civic package contract already exist, but source availability is inconsistent; a bounded official-source registry with expiry and visible freshness would make the existing News surface reliable.
rankedAdditions.firstRelease: Parks, trail closures, construction, and public-space notices for the ten most-used regions.
rankedAdditions.acceptance: Each notice has an official URL, location, effective/expiry semantics, source authority, and an explicit empty state when no current notice exists.

rankedAdditions.whyNow: The map and filters already recognize water, restrooms, benches, shade, crossings, barriers, and accessibility tags; normalizing these into route-relevant amenities produces immediate practical value.
rankedAdditions.firstRelease: Verified restrooms, drinking water, benches, shade, accessible entrances, crossings, and known barriers around published loops.
rankedAdditions.acceptance: Records distinguish mapped presence from verified availability and retain source/date; routing never infers accessibility from absence of a barrier.

rankedAdditions.whyNow: The app already has watershed learning and water layers; clipped NHD flowlines would turn a static basin fact into a named corridor and route companion.
rankedAdditions.firstRelease: Difficult Run, Accotink Creek, Scotts Run, Pimmit Run, and Four Mile Run.
rankedAdditions.acceptance: Named flowlines are clipped to the region, carry source vintage and URL, and are rendered as discoverable lines rather than point floods.

rankedAdditions.whyNow: Biodiversity is already a first-class Learn surface with local notes and an iNaturalist handoff; expanding the static sidecar coverage is lower-cost than inventing a new product surface.
rankedAdditions.firstRelease: Use GBIF/iNaturalist/eBird only for regional, time-qualified records with clear historical/community wording.
rankedAdditions.acceptance: No record implies current presence; every card carries source, observation vintage, and the existing uncertainty language.

rankedAdditions.whyNow: It is strategically foundational for regional packages, but its exporter/worker/validation work is larger than the additions above.
rankedAdditions.firstRelease: One validated DC/Fairfax package with typed unavailable/no-route failures and offline reload verification.
rankedAdditions.acceptance: No straight-line fallback, graph checksums pass, worker search is bounded, and routing works with network disabled.

doNotDoYet: nationally broad news crawling without an official-source contract
large POI expansion without a walker encounter
captainCall.reason: The first three choices compound: a route gives the user a reason to walk, current signals keep it trustworthy, and comfort/access data makes it usable in real conditions.
